axis_choice: R0 contains 2171 dots at 2<d_catalogue<=3 px. Only PRUNE is exempt from the >=3 px collar constraint, so a non-PRUNE child of R0 cannot be gate-clean without a second axis. The feature-based axes are also blocked by the absent pinned training_features stack.

routing_support.role: Parent-lineage binary ridge support only; not truth, not a score, and not a new physical-signal field.

refill_rule: For each collar, remove every R0 dot at d_catalogue<=threshold and refill the same number from H19-5 support strictly outside that collar by exact iterative marginal-DTI coverage order. No minimum-spacing inhibition is applied; nearest-neighbour drift is measured and disclosed.
why_no_d28_inhibition: A dry feasibility check before candidate construction found only 722, 621, and 498 d2.8-legal cells for the required 941, 1611, and 4848 refills. Preserving d2.8 would make every fixed-count dose impossible. The no-inhibition amendment is part of the PRUNE refill rule, not a spacing objective.
prediction_basis: Interpolation/extrapolation of prior MODEL-only PRUNE anchors (p3px +0.005, p4px -0.009 in this ledger; p4.3px -0.013 in the recorded sibling sweep). No RECEIPT exists. These are hypotheses, not fitted live effects.

variants.hypothesis: The 2.236 px shell still contains redundant immediate-flank detections; relocating that small dose to uncovered parent-lineage ridges will retain useful coverage while reducing catalogue-side-lobe mass.
Adding the 2.828 px shell should provide the largest below-3px benefit before the separately built 3px collar; fixed count separates relocation from the earlier delete-only mass effect.
Beyond the existing 4.3px bracket, removal of genuine secondary splays is expected to dominate refill gains. This is an upper falsification bracket, not a first-choice upload.

live_evidence_rule: An absolute live change below 0.01 is no evidence on public chunks; private chunks may differ.
report_only_after_build: catalogue hide-and-recover PROXY with withheld-positive counts and 95% CI
single-feature leakage canary; AUC>0.90 requires investigation

references.claim: Known catalogue pixels are masked pixel-exactly; adjacent pixels are scored normally and new truth may occur near known traces.
New-fault truth includes newly mapped geometry of existing systems.
GeoDAWN Area 2 flight spacing supplies positional-uncertainty context, not target labels.
